Maria: Quick heads-up — finance is running a one-time reallocation of unused global credits into a ‘surplus pool’ to cover urgent procurement and shortfall requests across teams. We want this to be low-friction but controlled. :wave:
Alex: Nice. Who's eligible to request from the pool?
Maria: Any product/infra/eng team with a demonstrated near-term spend need (latency infra, test GPUs, critical vendor services). Priority: safety/security > infra SLOs > experiments.
Sam: Process? forms? approvals?
Maria: Short process: 1) Submit the short request form (link below) with vendor, amount, cost center code, and justification. 2) Tag @Finance in the thread. 3) Finance will triage within 48h. Auto-approve limit is $5k; above $5k needs controller sign-off.
Maria: Form snippet:
```
- name:
- team:
- cost_center:
- vendor:
- amount_requested:
- justification (1-2 sentences):
- PO_required_by_date (if vendor needs it)
```
Jordan: If vendor onboarding is slow, can we expedite?
Maria: Yes — temporary expedited onboarding is available for requests from this pool. Mark the form field "expedite_onboarding": true and add a short security justification. ProcureOps will try to clear KYC + contract reviews in 5 business days. PO still required ASAP.
ProcureBot: :robot_face: Expedite flag received? Use `/procure expedite <request-id>` after you submit the form to ping the team.
Alex: How will this show up on reports? We need to tag experiments so we don't blow forecast.
Maria: All disbursements will be tagged `surplus_pool` and rolled up in the monthly finance export. Please include the internal project tag in the form so we map it to your forecast.
Sam: Any cost-center mapping exceptions?
Maria: If your cost center is closed or capped, add a brief note and we'll map to a temporary holding code. Finance will reconcile within the month and backfill with committed budget where possible.
Maria: Final note — this pool is intended as a short-term buffer. If your needs are ongoing, we'll work with your manager to shift runway in the next budget cycle. We'll start reallocations Monday morning. If you need us to hold any anticipated charges, DM me before EOD Friday. :calendar:
